overview: Your house's bill is the old Hamlet. The Rose's is a new play, The New World's Tragedy. You read that title twice. A new world, a fortnight after Drake sailed. You did not cross the river.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the second title twice, and did not go across.
